sloka: अरण्यम् विचरामि इदम् एका सर्व भयंकरा ।रावणो नाम मे भ्राता यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः ॥३-१७-२१॥
transliteration: araṇyam vicarāmi idam ekā sarva bhayaṁkarā ।rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā yadi te śrotram āgataḥ ॥3-17-21॥

translations.english: My name is Surpanakha. I am a demoness who can assume any form at will, I move in this forest alone, unleashing a reign of terror.
